images.filename: Arquiduquesa Isabel da Áustria - Carta manuscrita assinada em Bruxelas (1628).jpg
images.caption: An extremely rare manuscript letter wrote by Archduchess Isabel of Austria, about the first Dutch invasions in Brazil. It refers to the soldiers who fought in Todos-os-Santos Bay. Signed and dated, Brussels, June 20, 1628. Ricardo Brennand Institute collection, Recife, Brazil.
images.alt: An extremely rare manuscript letter wrote by Archduchess Isabel of Austria, about the first Dutch invasions in Brazil. It refers to the soldiers who fought in Todos-os-Santos Bay. Signed and dated, Brussels, June 20, 1628. Ricardo Brennand Institute collection, Recife, Brazil.
images.artist: Archduchess Isabel of Austria, Governor of the Netherlands (1566-1633)

images.caption: An extremely rare manuscript letter signed by John IV of Portugal, written in Lisbon and dated January 20th, 1647. It refers to the decision of the King of Portugal to send to Recife a reinforcement of 200 men to assist the expulsion of the Dutch. A key-document for the preparations of the Guararapes battle. Ricardo Brennand Institute collection, Recife, Brazil.

images.filename: Atlas Van der Hagen-KW1049B13 095-PRAEFECTURAE PARANAMBUCAE PARS BOREALIS, una cum PRAEFECTURA de ITAMARACA.jpeg
images.caption: Between 1630 and 1654 a large part of Brazil was occupied by the Dutch. In this period the area was surveyed and mapped by the cartographers Cornelis Goliath (deceased 1667/1668) and Georg Marcgraf. The results were compiled in a decorative wall map in 1643. Joan Blaeu (1598-1673) used the wall map as his source for this map in 1662.
images.alt: Between 1630 and 1654 a large part of Brazil was occupied by the Dutch. In this period the area was surveyed and mapped by the cartographers Cornelis Goliath (deceased 1667/1668) and Georg Marcgraf. The results were compiled in a decorative wall map in 1643. images.caption:
Cabo de Santo Agostinho - Pe.
In this region the Spanish Viscente Pizzon arrived in Brazil on January 26, 1500. Three months later Pedro Alvares Cabral apportioned in Porto Seguro in Bahia.

Nessa região o Espanhol Viscente Pizzon chegou ao Brasil em 26 de janeiro de 1500. Tres meses depois Pedro Alvares Cabral aportava em Porto Seguro na Bahia.
